fact: The Operation Vulindlela Q1 2026/27 report (National Treasury and the Presidency) says work progressed during the quarter on updating the Minimum Interoperability Standards and the Government-Wide Enterprise Architecture, with the updated standards to be progressed and tested in priority digital services by September 2026; the quarter ended June 2026, so as_of is the quarter, not the 2026-07-31 publication.
